description.en: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace, Left/Right switch workspaces. Identity comes from the client controllers, not the DOM, and arrow keys are yielded back to the composer whenever a draft is being edited.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的方向键导航：上/下在当前工作区内切换会话，左/右切换工作区。身份来自客户端控制器而非 DOM；编辑草稿时方向键交还给输入框。
